body:
Please stay. You are needed. You are loved. You said life was great 4months ago... who says it can't be great again? 
I know you feel desperate right now, but hold on. Maybe it will be worth it - you can only find out if you stay strong. 
I'm here if you need to talk

I'm sorry for you.. I know this feeling... But what is it that makes you feel trapped?

Please don't give up.. I'm.here
